_help.stackedAspect: When the free space is this many times taller than wide (or more), the tray goes BELOW the board; otherwise BESIDE it. Higher = the tray stays beside the board on more screens. 1.15 = a bit taller than square. Try 1–1.3.
_help.trayTileMin: Tray seeds are the same width as a board hex but never smaller than this (44 = comfortable finger size). If 8 don't fit in a row they wrap to 2 rows of 4 before shrinking. Higher = bigger, easier-to-tap seeds. Try 40–52.
_help.trayGap: Higher = more space between the seeds in the tray. Try 4–10.
_help.sidePanelShare: When the tray sits beside the board, how much of the width it takes (0.3 = 30%). Higher = a wider tray and a smaller board. Try 0.25–0.35.
_help.boardMargin: Higher = more breathing room round the board, so the board is drawn smaller. Try 0.2–0.5.
_help.dragLift: When dragging with a finger, the piece sits this far above it so your finger doesn't hide it. Higher = floats higher. Try 40–72.
_help.dragStartDistance: Move less than this and it counts as a tap. Higher = harder to start a drag by accident, but drags take longer to start. Try 6–12.
_help.promptGap: With the tray below the board, the space between the board and the instruction line. Higher = more room, so the board doesn't crowd the words. Try 8–20.
_help.bottomRoom: Extra empty space under the tray and buttons, so dragging a seed up or tapping a bottom button doesn't trigger the phone's home / back swipe. 24 clears Android and iPhone gesture bars. Try 16–32.
_help.edgeMargin: Space kept round the top, sides and bottom of the game screen (on top of the phone's own safe area), so the portrait, Menu button, board and tray never touch the edge. Higher = more room. Try 12–24.
_help.revealBigZoom: End-of-game reveal on a roomy screen (a desktop, a big board): how much bigger the players' Magic chips are drawn, so they match the big board. 1 = the normal size. Try 1.2–1.8.
_help.edgeMarginShare: On big screens the edge space grows: this share of the screen's shorter side (0.035 ≈ 32 pixels on a 900-tall desktop), used whenever it is more than the pixel setting above. Higher = more room on big screens. Try 0.02–0.05.

_labels.stackedAspect: Seed tray below or beside the board: the switch point (screen shape)
_labels.sidePanelShare: Seed tray beside the board: share of the screen width (0–1)
_labels.promptGap: Phone portrait: gap between the board and the instruction text (pixels)
_labels.edgeMargin: Screen edges: empty space kept clear (pixels)
_labels.revealBigZoom: End reveal on a big screen: Magic chips size (×)
_labels.edgeMarginShare: Screen edges on big screens: space as a share of the screen
_labels.bottomRoom: Seed tray: room below it for the phone's gesture bar (pixels)
_labels.dragLift: Drag: how far the piece floats above your finger (pixels)
_labels.dragStartDistance: Drag: how far to move before a press becomes a drag (pixels)
